# brig service start

Start a service

## Synopsis

```text
brig service start NAME
```

## Description

Start a service: its VM, as [`brig start`](brig-start.md) does, or its controller on the host.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--wait` | fail unless the gateway answers and the OpenShell config directories sync |

The [global options](brig.md#options) of brig apply too.
